newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gencor jumps on Canadian asset sale deal.
newsitem.headline: Gencor jumps on Canadian asset sale deal.

text.p: Shares in Gencor Ltd rose on Friday following news that the South African gold mining house had signed a $193.6 million rand deal with Canada's Eldorado Gold Corp Ltd, dealers said.
By about 0800 GMT Gencor was up 25 cents at 20.70 rand -- a new year high -- after 131,100 shares had changed hands.
"I think they are going up on the back of this announcement that they are selling some gold assets to a Canadian company in exchange for some shares," one dealer said.
The dealer said market players regarded the announcement made on Thursday as positive.
"It (Gencor share) actually started running yesterday and I think it's on the back of this (announcement). It is quite a positive story," the dealer added.

Gencor announced on Thursday it had signed a memorandum of understanding with Eldorado Gold Corp Ltd, whereby Eldorado will acquire from Gencor a porfolio of mining, development and exploration assets in Ghana and South Africa.
Dealers said the deal was also seen as positive for Gencor, easing woes a dull bullion price had presented recently.

"There is a lot of cash coming in for Gencor now. The gold price at the moment is not that good and I think if you can get a partner to share the cost and help you out while the share is at the lower levels that may be why the deal is seen as positive," a dealer added.
